| description = 

''Moosh felt a fierce pride as he surveyed the troop: veterans of many a battle and like himself, descended from the original ogres who had been Najena’s sole defenders when she left Neriak so many years ago to begin her lone research. Every one among them was fiercely loyal to Moosh and to their mistress, and they would not fail her now.''

There seem to be two varieties of guards in [[Najena]]: lower level [[Warrior]]s which patrol near the zone entrance and [[Drelzna]]'s castle and higher level [[Shadow Knight]]s around [[the guard captain]]'s castle. Shadow Knights HT for -231. 

The different levels seem to have different drop rates for the armor. For the level 14/15 Guards at the entrance to Najena seem incapable of dropping [[Large Bronze Armor]], or it is very rare, while they drop [[Large Ringmail Armor]] rarely. The higher level guards near the jail seem to have a higher chance of dropping either Large Bronze/Ringmail and Large Raw-hide is Ultra-Rare on either level range.
